Text.Text: The unsafe test program is over. Set your own charges with more care than that crew showed. You've finished my Frag Grenade trials. I have no further work for you here.
Live-range clearance requires rank 50 in Devices. Reach it, then return. I won't send untrained hands into live ordnance.

A crew at the Qion site is building oversized charges without a containment plan. Recover their log before another test becomes a crater. Defeat six Thermal Detonator Adepts in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Qion Test Log; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost. I'll give you the Hutlar Qion Test Site Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Frag Grenade.

Here's the Hutlar Qion Test Site Key. Use 'Qion Test Site' in Hutlar, Qion Box Canyon. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Thermal Detonator Adepts, then return with the Thermal Detonator Qion Test Log.

Thermal Detonator is the name of the school you're confronting. The technique these trials qualify you to learn is Frag Grenade. Recovering its records and defeating its master will show me you're ready for that training.
Charges built past rated yield, no containment casing, no logged fuze timing. That is not testing, that is gambling with a blast radius. I want the log that tells me how far they pushed it.
Everything I need and nothing I want to hear. Fuze curve, yield estimate, whoever signed off on it. Bring it back whole; a torn page tells me less than no page at all.
Defeat six Thermal Detonator Adepts in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Qion Test Log; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost.
You've defeated six Thermal Detonator Adepts. Let me see the Thermal Detonator Qion Test Log.
Now I have a record of their modifications. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are pushing the cold-weather regulator beyond safe limits. Bring it back for inspection. Defeat five Thermal Detonator Specialists in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Cryo-Range Regulator; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost.
Your key still grants access to Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Defeat five Thermal Detonator Specialists to secure the Thermal Detonator Cryo-Range Regulator, then return to me.
Cryo-shatter, not a clean burn. It sprays supercooled shrapnel through anyone standing near it, then whatever's left cooks off anyway. I've buried range hands for less.
Because pushing yield past spec is the only way their numbers make their masters happy. I've seen it before. It never ends with the regulator; it ends with the person holding it.
Strip it down on my bench, find out how far past spec they pushed it, and use that number to keep the next fool honest. Small mercy, but it's the one I've got.
Defeat five Thermal Detonator Specialists in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Cryo-Range Regulator; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost.
You've defeated five Thermal Detonator Specialists. Let me see the Thermal Detonator Cryo-Range Regulator.
I'll inspect this before anything goes back into service. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the crew's live tests. Recover the test crest and end that watch. Defeat the Thermal Detonator Warden in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Frostburned Test Crest; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Hutlar, Qion Test Site, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Thermal Detonator Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Thermal Detonator Frostburned Test Crest.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Thermal Detonator Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

It's frostburned, which means whatever the warden's setting off now runs colder and meaner than anything on the books. I want that crest to know what I'm dealing with before it becomes everyone's problem.
Detonators staged in pairs, timed to catch whoever survives the first one. Ugly, efficient, exactly the kind of lesson I'd teach if I'd gone the wrong way with this work.

Defeat the Thermal Detonator Warden in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Frostburned Test Crest; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Thermal Detonator Warden. Let me see the Thermal Detonator Frostburned Test Crest.
That confirms who was in charge of the unsafe work. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior operators still authorize the unsafe charges. Take their override chip. Defeat four members of the Thermal Detonator Inner Circle in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Site Chief's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost.
Your key still grants access to Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Defeat four members of the Thermal Detonator Inner Circle to secure the Thermal Detonator Site Chief's Override Chip, then return to me.
Every override past safety lockout, timestamped and signed. That chip is a confession that doesn't know it's one yet.
On paper, nobody. In practice, whoever the warden answered to, and whoever they answer to still hasn't shown their face. I have a guess, and I don't like it.
Wouldn't hurt. Four of them together is worse odds than one warden alone, even if none of them hit as hard.

Defeat four members of the Thermal Detonator Inner Circle in Hutlar, Qion Test Site. Their defeat secures the Thermal Detonator Site Chief's Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost.
You've defeated four members of the Thermal Detonator Inner Circle. Let me see the Thermal Detonator Site Chief's Override Chip.
No more unauthorized orders from that crew. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the last operator behind the unsafe testing. Defeat him in the Overload Chamber to finish the trial. Defeat the Thermal Detonator Master in Hutlar, Overload Chamber. Report back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Hutlar, Overload Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Thermal Detonator Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.
The warden staged charges. The master reads a room and places them where the room will actually be standing, which is worse. He's not testing ordinance anymore, he's testing people.
Because I trained half his methods into people who never should have kept them. Thermal Detonator was supposed to end with better range discipline than this. Instead it ended with him.
Then the site's mine again, and Thermal Detonator's yours. I don't hand that over to just anyone, and I'm not planning to regret handing it to you.

Defeat the Thermal Detonator Master in Hutlar, Overload Chamber. Report back to me here in Hutlar, Outpost; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Thermal Detonator Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The unsafe test program is over. Set your own charges with more care than that crew showed. You've earned the right to train Frag Grenade. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the proof.
I'll defeat six Thermal Detonator Adepts.
How does this school relate to Frag Grenade?
What is this crew actually building in there?
What will the test log tell you?
Not yet. I've got other business.
Here's the Thermal Detonator Qion Test Log.
Back to the proof.
I'll defeat five Thermal Detonator Specialists.
What happens if the regulator cracks?
Why are specialists running it hot?
What will you do with the regulator once I bring it?
Give me a day first.
Here's the Thermal Detonator Cryo-Range Regulator.
Back to the proof.
I'll defeat the Thermal Detonator Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What does the crest prove?
What's this warden's specialty?
I need to find people first.
Here's the Thermal Detonator Frostburned Test Crest.
Back to the proof.
I'll defeat four members of the Thermal Detonator Inner Circle.
What's on an override chip like that?
Who's actually running this site?
Should I bring the same crew back?
Not right now.
Here's the Thermal Detonator Site Chief's Override Chip.
Back to the proof.
I'll face the Thermal Detonator Master and report back.
What makes him different from the warden?
Why do you know his methods so well?
What happens after he's down?
I need more time before that fight.
The Thermal Detonator Master is defeated. Here's my report.
